HAIRDO.definition: The arrangement of the hair (especially a woman's hair).

HOARD.gloss: a secret store of valuables or money
HOARD.definition: A secret store of valuables or money.

HARD.gloss: not easy; requiring great physical or mental effort to accomplish or comprehend or endure
HARD.definition: Not easy; requiring great physical or mental effort to accomplish or comprehend or endure.

HAIR.gloss: a covering for the body consisting of a dense growth of threadlike structures
HAIR.definition: A covering for the body (or parts of it) consisting of a dense growth of threadlike structures (as on the human head); helps to prevent heat loss.

ROD.gloss: a long thin implement made of metal or wood
ROD.definition: A long thin implement made of metal or wood.

AIR.gloss: a mixture of gases required for breathing
AIR.definition: A mixture of gases (especially oxygen) required for breathing; the stuff that the wind consists of.

ROAD.gloss: an open way for travel or transportation
ROAD.definition: An open way (generally public) for travel or transportation.

AID.gloss: a person or thing that is a resource that helps make something easier or possible to do
AID.definition: A person or thing that is a resource that helps make something easier or possible to do.

RAID.gloss: search without warning, make a sudden surprise attack on
RAID.definition: Search without warning, make a sudden surprise attack on.
RAID.example: The police raided the crack house.

IRA.gloss: belligerence aroused by a real or supposed wrong
IRA.definition: Belligerence aroused by a real or supposed wrong (personified as one of the deadly sins).
